scope: Every current sofa/sectional/loveseat/chaise and two genuine convertible single-chair sofa states; ordinary chairs and beds excluded.
researchUse: Construction and material study only. Product photography is not a texture license. New texture provenance is tracked separately.

sources.observed: Track arms, plump attached backs and separate seats, chenille-feel polyester, dark exposed feet. Interpret the differentiated cushions and fine marled textile without copying the branded design.
Midcentury tufting and piping, solid wood feet and corner-blocked construction. Use leg grain, authentic seam sizes and tensioned upholstery.
Low deep profile and hand-finished upholstery with chenille, velvet and canvas options. Vary fibre response without applying a coarse uniform weave.
Slim track arms, deep low seats and substantial separate seat/back cushions over a hardwood frame. Preserve crisp panel boundaries and soft matte fabric.
Tibbleby is a discreet herringbone polyester with slight lustre and removable covers. Fine twill direction and tone-on-tone tailoring suit everyday modular sectionals.

Wool/viscose yarn dyed before spinning provides layered colour and textile depth. Reproduce the general fine yarn/melange principle with original or licensed maps, not photographed proprietary swatches.
Solution-dyed outdoor fabrics retain color through the fibre. Outdoor cushions should read as taut woven canvas, with bound edges and restrained normal variation.
Oak, ash, maple and walnut are used as solid wood and quality veneer. Grain belongs along rails/legs; different pieces need shifted grain phases and fine pores.
